about.budget: the four derived files together stay under 200 KB (spec §6), written as compact JSON (indented they would be about 237 KB); excerpts are capped at 240 (step), 400 (reply) and 120 (args, task) characters
about.distinct_recorded_cost_usd: the ledger cost of each distinct recording the runs used, counted once
about.judge: the eval's judge set (agents/evals/run_evals.py): recordings = the judge requests the current traces ask for that the store holds; orphans = judge store files no current request uses (R73)
about.model_calls: the proxy_calls entries over the set's runs
about.not_recorded: {"recorded": false, "command": ...} where a trace is missing, never a number
about.orphans: R67: the store files for the set that no run references (superseded by a later re-record); replay never reads them, and agents/prune.py deletes them (R73)
about.record: paid, after the user approves the printed estimate (add --dry-run to see it); the judge set is recorded by agents/evals/run_evals.py --record-judge
about.recorded_cost_usd: the ledger cost over the set's runs (R62): what the recorded calls cost, counted per run, so a recording that serves two runs counts twice; not what the recording session paid (a store hit is free)
about.recordings: R67: the distinct recordings the set's runs used (distinct proxy_calls keys over its traces); a replay of the set serves exactly these
about.replay: free: replays every model call from the store and runs the real lumen tools; a request the store does not hold stops with a 404 naming the record command, never a paid call

rulings.R62: cost and latency come from the recording: the sum of the trace's proxy_calls cost_usd and ms, served again on replay; never what one run paid (spent, cost_usd) or measured locally (a record's ms)
rulings.R64: the ledger keeps input, cache-write, cache-read and output tokens apart; cache writes are priced at 1.25x and cache reads at 0.10x the input price, so prompt caching shows as a lower cost
rulings.R66: the gate stays as built (0.7 minus the 1/sqrt(n) band); with 13 tickets no engine clears it. That is the real result and is shown as it is, never adjusted

about.runs: traces present out of expected_runs (desks x tickets); complete when every run has a trace
about.what: Lesson 7 (record and replay): each recording set, what it holds and what it cost to record
